scope: Submitted wallpaper search paging and rendered selection authority in online and live wallpaper pickers.
changes: Explicit Search submits the draft query from page one; paging retains the submitted provider and query.
Online page/card/download callbacks retain the result item and its presentation or selection lifetime; new searches clear old bounds and reject inconsistent provider/page responses.
Live cards retain the source descriptor and library lifetime; Apply retains its source and selection/target lifetime.
Refresh, replacement results, changed selection/target and close/reopen retire older controls; same-source preview and viewport updates preserve current authority.
Root admission rejects stale rendered actions before reserving work or reporting unrelated writable-settings errors.
Closed panel callbacks cannot start panel work, while explicit global CLI commands and admitted worker deliveries retain their own authority.
Online dismissal retires controls without cancelling an accepted download; live dismissal still retires pending import delivery.
Browser subscriptions receive only injected WallpaperCatalogPort and AssetPort dependencies.
Search/page/download buttons share admission predicates with enabled visuals and pointer/Tab availability.
Generated wallpaper-browser tokens bound result metadata to one line and status text to two.

coverage_authored: Actual rendered page callbacks after a draft edit, submitted-search paging and explicit new Search.
Online cards/downloads across provider/page/result replacement and A-to-B-to-A selection, invalid page responses and retired rendered search/form controls.
Live cards across valid recycled indices, changed descriptors, Refresh and close/reopen.
Live Apply across source/target replacement and A-to-B-to-A, while frame/viewport/same-source reselect preserve current actions.
Busy or repeated Apply, retired forms/close controls, exact imported targets and exhausted generation guards.
Root stale callbacks produce no reservation/import/save/error; global closed-panel commands remain usable; fresh captured Apply and duplicate completion routing are covered.
Injected provider query/download recording; disabled pointer/Tab state and bounded metadata/status layout at 320/640 widths and 240/580 heights in both themes.
Python architecture guard excludes the root adapter bundle from the wallpaper browser child.

hosted_attempts.failure: New refresh fixture expected no subscription before the cancelled preview returned. Production retains cancellation ownership until Ended. Fixture now executes and delivers the real terminal acknowledgement before asserting no subscription, retaining stale-action checks.
